{{Quote|This says she plotted with Dernas and the Reds to kill the Grand Lord!"<br />"And the other says she plotted with Pallima and his people.|[[Orielle Kitai]] and [[Flen Luzo]], reading scrolls signed by Kitai's mother, [[Candra Kitai|Candra]]|<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gold Faction''' was a political party of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Its members wore a gold sash to distinguish them from their major rivals, the [[Red Faction]], and its leader was given his or her own private box at the [[Korsinata]]. In [[3961 BBY]], the Golds and their rivals were forced to work together to elect a new [[Grand Lord]] for the Tribe. Unable to agree on a suitable Grand Lord, the Gold and Red factions compromised on [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]], the eldest of the High Lords. As of [[3960 BBY]], High Lord [[Pallima]] led the faction, though he was killed after participating in a conspiracy to [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|assassinate]] Grand Lord Venn.
